notes.title: Gesture VR Update April 2024
notes.content:
We have a new update for Gesture VR which brings the features up to par with the Quest/Vive XR Elite versions. In this update you will find various fixes across the board as well as a few new features such as skeletal poses for some male models, new modes including a guided drawing mode, higher visual fidelity on models, new updated tutorials, updated sound design and more.

Please enjoy the changes and happy sketching!

notes.title: Notes for April 2024
notes.content:
-Added new Main Menu
-Added new Tutorials from Proko
-Updated App Drawing Tutorials
-Added new Modes (Open Studio, Guided mode, Multiplayer)
-Increased Model Fidelity
-Added Skeletal poses for some male models
-Updated Sound Effects + Eraser Sound
-Optimized drawing tools
-Fixed an assortment of bugs and improved inputs on non-Quest headsets.

notes.title: Gesture VR is Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello artists, after much delay, we are finally live and coming in hot with a 15% launch discount. 
Please let us know what you think and if you find issues or have suggestions head on over to our support discord: https://discord.gg/dRftnsAMyB
We plan on making some quality-of-life improvements throughout the year.

notes.title: Gesture VR is Releasing this week!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43058331/251bf6a34841830a00d0d27c6cf1160c44653a65.gif[/img]

Pleased to announce that Gesture VR will finally be available for PCVR users starting this Thursday. As you know, we hit some unexpected delays. We needed to capture all new models and do a lot of back-and-forth with the folks at Valve. This version will have all the same features as the quest version (minus the passthrough). 

It's also worth noting that due to a stipulation by Steam, we were required to make the app adult-only. This means the game may not be available in all countries and won't show up if you don't have adult content enabled. If you're reading this, you're probably fine.

Again, we apologize for the delay and hope you enjoy the app.

notes.title: Regarding the Delay
notes.content:
Hello artists, we had hoped to release in time for the holidays on December 6th. 

Unfortunately, we hit several unanticipated roadblocks in the Steam approval process, which have delayed the release. We believe that by addressing these issues, the app should come out even stronger. This is our first app, and we're learning a lot as we go.

Please bear with us and follow our newsletter as we share news in the coming months.

Happy Holidays,

Nick

notes.title: Steam Release Date Delayed
notes.content:
Due to circumstances out of our control, the Steam version of Gesture VR will be experiencing a slight delay.  The reason is that we waited too long before submitting the app for Steam review, and it didn't have time to undergo the approval process. We had hoped the review would go through just in time and we wouldn't have to make this announcement, but unfortunately, it did not.

We don't expect this to delay the launch for long, and we're hopeful that the app will be released within the next week. We will share news of the release once it's available. 

This delay does not affect the Meta Quest version, which can be found here starting today: https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5552836748069534/

You can also join our new discord for discussions around the app as well as being a place to report bugs:
https://discord.gg/tU2FvUKx

We apologize for the delay.

Nick
